goal: Publish verified supplier videos and a truthful idempotent join receipt email on VII.

intent_model.literal_request: Finish sections 2 and 4 completely, publish, then obtain maker and simulated-Adir approval.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Visitors can watch the correct place video and receive a real confirmation email after joining, with production proof.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Implementation, publication and natural-destination verification are all required.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: No approval without exact production build, functional and visual evidence.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: The visitor watches a verified place video or submits one join request.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Play the video or complete the join form.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Watch the media or retain the emailed reference and wait for the team response.

natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co place galleries and join routes.

facts.claim: The cumulative source contains 156 verified place mappings and at least 164 videos.
The existing join proxy forwards leads to the global lead service.

assumptions.claim: The production Site has the existing configured Resend quality sender.
assumptions.validation: Read production environment metadata through the authorized owner route or prove one live receipt after deployment.

in_scope: Preserve API and verified legacy video fields
Render safe place-scoped video in the gallery
Send one join receipt from VII when upstream did not confirm one
invariants: No email delivery claim without confirmation
All later cumulative fixes remain in the release

requirements.statement: Every verified supplier video remains attached only to its owning active place and plays safely in the public gallery.
requirements.source: User section 2 and VII feedback standard

requirements.statement: Every valid join submission creates one lead and sends at most one non-sensitive receipt to the submitted address, with a truthful visible delivery state.
The exact cumulative candidate is published and verified on desktop and mobile with rollback retained.
Recover the owning publication route after the root Sites connector returned project_not_found.

acceptance_checks.setup: A public place has a verified API or migrated legacy video.
acceptance_checks.action: Open its gallery, select Videos and play the item.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Only the owning video appears and a safe YouTube privacy embed or verified MP4 plays.

acceptance_checks.setup: A video URL is unsafe, malformed or belongs to another place.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The video is rejected and no image or video is borrowed to hide the gap.

acceptance_checks.setup: A valid join form and configured provider.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The lead succeeds, one provider message ID confirms the receipt, and the success screen says the email was sent.

acceptance_checks.setup: The same submission identity is repeated after an uncertain result.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The stable idempotency key prevents a duplicate receipt and no false success is invented.

acceptance_checks.setup: The provider is missing, rejects or times out.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The lead result remains truthful and the UI does not claim an email was sent.

acceptance_checks.action: Reload the place and join success destinations on desktop and mobile.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The correct gallery and receipt behavior persist on the same public build without overflow or stale assets.

acceptance_checks.action: Suspend edge admission and restore the previous saved Site version.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The prior public build is restored without changing DB, uploads, audience or DNS.

acceptance_checks.setup: The root Sites connector cannot find the historical project.
acceptance_checks.action: Use the verified owning Cloud task or configured project publication route.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The exact candidate is saved and deployed by the existing owner route, without creating a replacement Site.

authorization_boundary: One cumulative production publication and one bounded owner-controlled join receipt test are authorized. Preserve audience, environment, database, media, DNS and unrelated integrations.
